content.name: Smart Minelayer
content.author: Chem O`Dun
content.description:
[h1]Smart Minelayer[/h1]
A ship order that deploys mines or laser towers in configurable geometric patterns (circle, square, hexagon, sphere, cube) around a point or object in space, then monitors and automatically replaces destroyed items.
[h2]Features[/h2] [list] [*] Deploy in circle, square, hexagon, sphere or cube patterns [*] Configurable spacing, distance, density and concentric layers [*] Works with any mine or laser tower type in the ship's cargo [*] Monitors deployed items and restocks when losses exceed a threshold [*] No cheating - the ship physically travels to each deploy position [/list]

text.name: Smart Minelayer
text.description: Deploy mines or laser towers in geometric patterns and auto-replace destroyed items.
